# Migration

> Schema versioning for saved profiles: register upgrade steps per version.

- Package: `Migration` · Category: Data & players
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Migration")` on the server

## `GaxiaServer.Migration`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**

local Migration = GaxiaServer.Migration
